jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Engineering at HelmGuard: How We Build with AI
At HelmGuard, we’re building an AI-native engineering organization from first principles. We work on hard, enterprise-grade problems and use the latest AI tooling not as an add‑on, but as a core part of how we design, build, and ship product. This is a snapshot of how we actually work day to day. 1. AI‑Native, Enterprise‑Scale Engineering
In our internal engineering efforts and in our product, we’re not “adding AI” to an existing stack, we’re designing around it from the ground up for critical institutions. This is reflected in some guiding principles: ● ● ● ● Aim for end-to-end (e2e): We believe the greatest productivity gains will come from automating workflows e2e. Multi-agent orchestration: To deliver e2e outcomes in the current paradigm, one must invest time and effort into multi-agent orchestration. We spend much of our time thinking about how our different agents consume each other’s outputs to work in tandem. Enterprise constraints from: We design for data sensitivity, auditability, reliability, and latency upfront. Our customers are large organizations with real operational risk; the bar for correctness and robustness is high. From prototype to production quickly: We move fast to test ideas, but the goal is always production deployment with real usage, not demos. If you’re interested in building serious, production AI systems that solve non‑toy problems for demanding customers, that’s the environment we offer. 2. Ownership and Trust at the Core
We’re an extremely small team, and every engineer is a true owner. ● ● ● ● Problem ownership: You don’t just “take tickets. ” You own problems from shaping the solution, through implementation, to measuring impact in production. High trust, high autonomy: We assume seniority in judgment by default. You’re trusted to choose the right tools, trade‑offs, and implementation details to hit the outcome. Tight‑knit collaboration: Despite the autonomy, we work very closely together in person 4–5 days a week. Design sessions at a whiteboard, pairing, and fast feedback cycles are normal. Direct line to customers and reality: Engineers are close to the customer problems we solve. You’ll see how your work lands in front of real users and influences revenue, not just internal metrics.We’re looking for people who enjoy being relied on, who want meaningful responsibility, and who are comfortable with the visibility that comes from being one of the first few engineers. 3. AI Tooling as a Force Multiplier (Unlimited Token Budget)
We are deliberately aggressive about AI usage. ● ● Unlimited token budget: We don’t artificially constrain your usage of models. So long as the EV is positive we are happy! Expected, not optional: Using AI well is a core part of the job. We expect you to lean on AI for: ○ ● ● exploring design options and implementation strategies ○ writing and refactoring code ○ generating tests and harnesses ○ analyzing logs, failures, and agent behaviour You design workflows, not just prompts: We care about how you structure interactions between humans, agents, and traditional services to achieve reliable outcomes. Learning the future of engineering: There’s a lot of noise in the market about “agents” and “AI replacing engineers. ” At HelmGuard you work on the concrete, practical version of this: how to make engineers 10x more effective by collaborating with AI systems. We are the place to work if you want to be on the cutting edge of what software engineering looks like in a few years. 4. Unique Opportunity: Early, Enterprise, Real Traction
Joining now means joining at an unusual intersection, at an early stage company backed by leading investors, hundreds of thousands of dollars in revenue and growing rapidly: ● ● ● ● Very early stage: You’ll be the 3rd engineer. Your decisions will shape architecture, product, and culture for years. Real enterprise work: We’re already operating in the enterprise space, with genuine customers who put us through serious evaluation and RFP processes. Proven product fit: Once prospects go deep with us, we win. That’s a strong signal that what we’re building actually works and matters. In‑office by design: We work together in person 4–5 days a week because the contact surface between people matters when you’re inventing something new. This is about speed, learning, and shared context, not clock‑watching. This isn’t a theoretical exploration of AI; it’s a small team using advanced tools to solve concrete, high‑stakes problems for demanding customers. 5. Who This Is ForYou might be a fit if you: ● ● ● ● Are excited about agentic systems, orchestration, and memory layers, not just “using an API. ” Want to own big chunks of productin a very small team, with clear business impact. Are comfortable trading some safety of a big company for the chance to shape how
AI‑native engineering is done. Value in‑person, high‑bandwidth collaborationand enjoy thinking deeply about engineering philosophy as well as implementation. If that sounds like the kind of environment where you’d grow, HelmGuard is set up to give you disproportionate leverage, responsibility, and learning around the future of AI‑powered engineering.

jobs.title: Data Science Lead
jobs.description:
We are seeking a technically-grounded Lead Data Scientist/ AI Leadto spearhead the AI transformation of a global, multi-billion dollar professional Legal services leader. This isn't a traditional "statistical" data science role; it is a builder’s rolefocused on engineering production-ready AI products. The organisation is currently investing tens of millions of pounds into its technology stack to redefine how its global workforce delivers high-stakes services. You will lead a high-performing team to commercialize business ideas into functional products using Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP, and Agentic workflows. What You’ll Do
Architect & Build:Lead the development of document-heavy AI applications, utilizing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LLM orchestration, and autonomous agents to navigate decades of complex case data. Productise AI:Move beyond POC's to ship scalable, production-grade tools that directly impact the firm’s commercial success. Collaborate with Experts:Act as the technical bridge between advanced engineering and high-level stakeholders (including legal and financial partners), requiring an ability to explain complex tech in a service-based environment. Technical Leadership:Mentor and guide a team of engineers while remaining hands-on with Python-based technical challenges and architectural decisions. Who You Are
Technical Background:You have a strong foundation in software engineering or machine learning engineering, with deep experience in applied AIrather than purely academic research. Relevant Experience:You likely have a background in services-based corporate environmentssuch as Financial Services (Banking/FinTech), Insurance, or top-tier technical consultancies. Tooling Expertise:Expert-level knowledge of Python, LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic), NLP, and modern data-driven architectures. Educational Excellence:A strong academic record from a top-tier institution (e.g., LSE, Cambridge, Oxford, Imperial) is highly desirable. Communication:You possess the ability to work with sophisticated stakeholders and the ability to turn abstract business requirements into technical reality. Why Join?
Impact:Work on the most significant technological shift in the history of the professional services sector. Stability & Scale:Access the resources and data of a 10,000-person global firm while maintaining the agility of a dedicated product team. Flexibility:Benefit from a culture that is dramatically more flexible regarding office time than traditional financial services or legal firms. Greenfield Work:Help build out a new powerhouse of tech within an established global brand.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
![BlockNote image](https://framerusercontent.com/images/tB06AzMSBBHG2hSJb59ebjw0hE.svg?width=98\&height=24) Senior Product Engineer (Backend) Build and shape the next generation of support tooling. £90k-£130k options London Plain is redefining customer support for the next generation of B2B companies. We’re building the fastest, most powerful platform to help companies move beyond reactive support and build true customer relationships. Some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies like Cursor, Raycast, and Granola trust Plain to unify all customer interactions, enable faster team collaboration, and supercharge their workflows with AI. B2B customer support is undergoing a seismic shift. AI is transforming the way companies engage with customers, shifting support from a siloed function to a company-wide effort across Slack, Discord, and any other channel you talk to customers in. The old way slow, manual, and disconnected no longer works. What you'll do
Engineering at Plain is about much more than moving tickets from left to right it’s about owning and solving problems end to end, from infrastructure decisions to feature design to button copy. You will: Help set product direction.You’ll contribute to both the technical architecture and the roadmap, balancing customer feedback with long-term product health. Ship features end to end.You’ll scope, build, and launch product features that directly solve customer problems. We’re structured into the following teams right now: Core Product:Own all customer-facing channels (Slack, Discord, Email, etc), core data models, and customer requests. You’ll balance moving fast to win customers with investing in strong foundations for the future. Developer Infra:Build the tools that every engineer at Plain depends on to ship and operate the product. Your focus is on making the team faster, removing roadblocks before they happen, and ensuring everything we build is easy to run, debug, and control in production. Shape our backend architecture.You’ll tackle some of our most complex challenges, from data modeling to high-performance reporting, and help set the standard for how we build across the company. Create a stellar developer experience.From data pipelines to APIs, you’ll make sure Plain is not only great to use but also great to build on. This is a great fit if you…
Thrive in early ideation stages, love sharing work-in-progress, and enjoy the balance of making trade-offs in order to ship high impact products. Are impact driven and motivated by seeing customers succeed. You measure the quality of your work by the end-experience of users, not the abstractions or cleanliness of the code. Have a proven track record working for product-led companies, ideally in B2B SaaS. You’re autonomous and able to prioritise your workload. You know when to take a shortcut and when to invest in long-term infrastructure. Have experience working with distributed, serverless systems, and have worked on similar web applications with a high quality and performance bar before Are equally at home in architectural conversations as you are in customer conversations. Can learn new technologies and paradigms quickly and independently. This won't be the right role if you…
Are uncomfortable with ambiguity. We have some really exciting traction but are still at an early stage and are constantly learning and trying new things as our company grows. Find learning about new technologies a key motivation for coming to work. We invest in what makes us productive but will prefer the known option to the experimental and novel. Postgres is great. Are looking to manage others. We're firmly looking for someone who, for now, wants to be an individual contributor. Expect all the perks of a big company. We’re a Series A startup and are competitive in what we offer at our stage, but it’s a different role and opportunity than working at an established tech company. [Apply for this role](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/plain/c2053301-23c4-46fd-9fe7-3c6425410819)
Benefits
Competitive comp structure
Competitive salary, and a generous option grant on employee-friendly terms. Team-wide offsites
Two global offsites per year in great locations, plus team-based offsites throughout the year. Generous time off
35 days annual leave including public holidays to take as you wish. First Friday of the quarter off
4 extra days off a year, a chance for all of us to recharge at the beginning of a quarter Private Health Insurance
100% employee coverage, dental and vision, access to out-of-network care. Also included: life insurance. $100 Monthly Wellness Credit
Expense up to $100/month for your gym membership, ClassPass, monthly massage… you name it! $1000 WFH stipend
If you join us remotely, you get a one-time $1,000 to set up your workspace and make sure you're productive. Retirement Planning
UK and Ireland: Employer matching up to 5%. USA: Contribute to your 401k pre-tax, with no employer match. © 2026 Plain

jobs.description: Job title: Product Engineer Location: London; full in-office working as default Start date: ASAP Reports to: CTO Compensation: £80,000 £120,000 Cosine at a glance At Cosine, we’re building autonomous AI engineers that plan, write, and ship code inside real development workflows. Cosine is designed for on-premise and virtual private cloud (VPC) deployments, including fully air-gapped environments. We build our agent tooling entirely in-house and post-train open-source models to deliver reliable, enterprise-grade coding performance in security-critical settings. In 2024, Cosine achieved a 72% score on OpenAI’s SWE-Lancer benchmark, placing us among the strongest real-world software-engineering AI systems evaluated. YC-backed and well-funded, Cosine was founded by experienced operators focused on building dependable, production-grade AI. This role is based in our Hoxton office, five days a week, because close collaboration, fast feedback, and shared context matter for the problems we’re solving. The role A Product Engineer at Cosine works closely across research, engineering, product, and design to turn advanced AI capabilities into intuitive, reliable tools for developers. You will be responsible for building and evolving Cosine’s user-facing product surfaces, including IDE extensions or dedicated apps and web applications that expose the power of our models through well-designed workflows and interfaces. Your work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and research, translating emerging model capabilities into concrete experiences developers can use every day. We focus on rapid product iteration without compromising quality. This means building systems that are performant, observable, and robust, while remaining flexible enough to evolve alongside fast-moving research and user needs. You will help define how developers interact with Cosine, from first use through advanced, production-grade workflows. Your Mission Deliver a scalable, high-quality Cosine product experience by building IDE and web application interfaces and integrations that expose the power of our models in intuitive, reliable ways. Responsibilities Build end-user products (editor extensions and web applications and platform capabilities) that integrate with the Cosine platform APIs Enable developers to use advanced language models to augment their workflows and problem-solving capabilities Collaborate closely research to explore and validate new product experiences and capabilities Translate emerging model capabilities into concrete, user-facing features Maintain a high bar for performance, reliability, and usability across platforms Be opinionated about and bring your own ideas to the table, we’re building for engineers, as an engineer you have a say in what you want to use. Skills & Experience Frontend & Application Development Experience building reactive, highly interactive applications (React, Svelte, Vue) Experience with cli application development or local software development is a plus Backend & Systems Comfortable with backend development Experience designing and consuming REST APIs Developer Experience Experience working with developer tooling Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines Experience with containerization Programming Languages Strong experience with TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks Knowledge of Node.js, Python, and Go is a plus Tooling & Infrastructure Git, Docker, Webpack, npm Monitoring and alerting tools (e.g. Grafana, Datadog) Feature flagging systems You Might Thrive in This Role If You: Have 5years of experience building production-grade software, with a strong emphasis on user-facing developer tools. Have shipped and maintained complex frontend or full-stack applications used by technical users. Are comfortable building highly interactive web or IDE-based experiences using modern frameworks (e.g. React, TypeScript). Have experience designing and consuming APIs, and understand how frontend and backend systems evolve together. Enjoy working close to the product surface, translating ambiguous ideas and model capabilities into intuitive developer workflows. Care deeply about developer experience, performance, and reliability—not just functionality. Are comfortable iterating quickly, running experiments, and refining products based on real user feedback. Can operate effectively in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities and incomplete information. Cosine is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and ways of thinking, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace. We encourage applications from anyone who meets the role requirements, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the hiring process, we’re happy to discuss them. Compensation, Benefits & Ways of Working We’re an in-office team, five days a week, by design. We believe the work we’re doing benefits from being together, collaborating closely, and building shared context. What you can expect: Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market Equity / share options, so you share in the upside you help create 30 days’ holiday bank holidays Genuine 9–5 working hours — we don’t expect late nights or weekend work Work hard in the office, collaborate closely, and switch off properly Dog-friendly office — bring your dog to work Daily lunch provided Monthly team breakfasts Monthly socials Pension High-quality equipment to do your best work We care about focus, sustainability, and doing great work — not performative overwork. We value people who show up, contribute thoughtfully, collaborate well with their colleagues, and then go home. This role won’t suit everyone. But if you want structure, clarity, strong collaboration, and a team that takes both the work and work-life balance seriously, it’s a great place to be.

🚀 YC S24 | InsurTech | AI humans Why this role exists Insurance is supposed to help people on the worst days of their lives.\
In reality, claims are slow, manual, and painful—for both customers and insurers. ClaimSortedbuilds the core infrastructure insurers use to receive claims, evaluate coverage, and issue payments—fast, accurately, and with empathy. We combine AI decisioning with human oversight, and we own the entireclaims workflow end-to-end. We’re YC S24, early, moving fast, and building systems that insurers rely on in production. This role exists because our product isour engineering—and we need someone who loves shipping real software that actually gets used. Example projects you would work on (first 6–12 months) You won’t be “supporting tickets” or polishing edge cases forever. You’ll own real systems. Example projects you might ship:
Build an end-to-end claims intake pipeline that processes documents, images, and structured data for multiple insurers—then scales from hundreds to thousands of claims per week Ship a reviewer interface that lets claims handlers override, audit, and trust AI decisions (used daily by real operators) Design and implement payout orchestration logic that moves claims from approval → payment with full auditability Improve system reliability and observability so insurers can trust ClaimSorted during peak claim events Work directly with insurers to turn messy real-world workflows into clean product abstractions If those sound exciting, you’ll probably like this job. Why strong engineers choose ClaimSorted Real impact, immediately– Your code directly affects whether someone gets paid after an accident or loss High ownership– You’ll build features end-to-end, not hand off specs to someone else Hard, interesting problems– AI human workflows, reliability, compliance, and real-world edge cases Speed > process– Small team, fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy Equity that matters– Early YC company, real upside if we win Founder proximity– Work directly with the people setting product and company direction This is a great role if you’d rather build something that matters than optimize dashboards at Big Tech. Who this role is for You’ll probably enjoy this role if: You like owning features from idea → production → iteration You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information You enjoy talking to users and translating chaos into product You care about reliability and correctness, not just shipping fast You want to help shape both the product andthe engineering culture If you’re looking for rigid tickets, narrow scope, or lots of process—this won’t be a fit. Tech stack Frontend:Next.js, TypeScript Backend:Node.js Infra:GCP, Terraform Data:Postgres Everything:built for reliability and scale from day one Interview process (fully transparent) We optimize for signal, not hoops: 3565. 20-min intro call– mutual fit 3566. 45-min technical screen– practical discussion, not trick puzzles 3567. 30-min culture interview– how we work 3568. Paid team day– come build with us (day / evening / weekend) We move quickly and respect your time. Practical details Location:London (6 days/week in-office) Visa:Skilled Worker visa sponsorship available Comp:£80k–£150k equity Time off:28 days annual leave 30 remote days Extras:Health insurance, offsites, small team energy Ready? If you want to ship real systems, own meaningful problems, and help reinvent how insurance claims work—apply. We’re excited to build with people who care about craft, speed, and impact.
